title: Dispatch: olv1 Pact of the Chain familiar forms (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Implementation plan for parent eshyra-olv1 (read `bd show eshyra-olv1` for the defect and remaining scope). Supervisor decisions below are made; STOP and record in notes if the code contradicts a premise.

WORKTREE/BRANCH: .worktrees/eshyra-olv1.1 on branch eshyra-olv1.1 (cut from origin/main 18e2e6ce). Deps already installed.

FILE BOUNDARY: a parallel task edits levelUpEngine.ts, rulesPackResolver.ts, state/usageCounters.ts, orchestrator/protocol.ts and docs/design/character-progression.md. Do NOT edit those.

MANDATORY READING: AGENTS.md "Deterministic rules-pack importer work", docs/importer-fix-protocol.md, docs/rules-pack-compiler.md. This bead changes curated pack structure and regenerates the pack; follow the protocol exactly (no hand-edited generated output, regenerate via the importer, source-fidelity guards).

CODE SURVEY
- Pack: feature:warlock:pact-boon choices[0] (id 'pact-boon', category 'other', options[] with id/name/text/source). Option pact-boon:pact-of-the-chain text: "When you cast the spell, you can choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite. Additionally, when you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its reaction." creature:imp, creature:pseudodragon, creature:quasit, creature:sprite exist.
- Option shape: packages/core/src/rules/featureChoices.ts FeatureChoiceOption (closed field set) validated by kindSchemas.validateDnd5eFeature; the importer derives choices in packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/deriveFeatureChoices.ts.
- spell:find-familiar mechanics.effects[0] summoning profile 'persistent-familiar', creation {kind 'fixed-form-menu', forms[{name, creatureRef}]} curated in packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/s1SummoningSpecs.ts (~line 1703), validated by packages/core/src/rules/summoningSchema.ts (~line 361).
- Runtime: packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts findBondedRecastTransition (~line 5370) takes forms from the record's creation.forms; recastBondedSummon (~line 5452) validates input.form against transition.forms (~line 5545). Find where the INITIAL familiar creation (start_effect / start_encounter linking the summoned creature) checks the chosen creature against creation.forms, if anywhere; the extension must apply there too.
- Caster identity: the effect's source actor (durable since eshyra-qxnc). A character caster's pact boon is persisted on CharacterSheet.featureChoices as {featureRef:'feature:warlock:pact-boon', choiceId:'pact-boon', optionIds:['pact-boon:pact-of-the-chain'], level}. Sheet store: createSqliteCharacterSheetStore(db).load(characterId).

DECISIONS
1. Pack structure: add an optional structured field to FeatureChoiceOption, `summonFormExtensions?: readonly {spell: string; forms: readonly {name: string; creatureRef: string}[]}[]` (validator: spell is a spell ref, forms non-empty, unique creatureRefs, creature refs well-formed). Curate it ONLY on pact-boon:pact-of-the-chain: spell 'spell:find-familiar', forms imp/pseudodragon/quasit/sprite -> creature:imp/pseudodragon/quasit/sprite. Add a source-fidelity guard in the importer: each form name must appear verbatim in the option's own text, and each creatureRef must resolve to a creature record in the pack (fail the import otherwise). Regenerate the pack with the importer and commit the regenerated artifacts. Run the SRD audits the protocol names; do not weaken any expectation.
2. Runtime: one helper that returns the extra creation forms a caster holds for a spell: for a character source actor, read the sheet's featureChoices, and for every held option (featureRef + optionId resolved through the pack feature's choice options) with a summonFormExtensions entry for this spell, return its forms. Non-character casters and sheets without the pick get none. Apply it in recastBondedSummon (allowed forms = record forms ∪ extensions; the error message lists the union) and at the initial creation check if one exists. If initial creation performs no form validation today, do not invent a new validation regime; record that in notes and in the module comment.
3. The Attack-action clause ("forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its reaction"): grep whether any deterministic engine path enforces the familiar's "can't attack" (e.g. a summoning modification consumed by an attack tool). If nothing enforces it, the clause is DM-adjudicated: document it in the module comment and on the bead; no engine change. If something does enforce it, STOP and report before designing an exception.
4. Do not touch the familiar creature statblocks or any other pact boon.

EVIDENCE (concise)
- Schema/importer: the curated field validates; the guard fails on a form name absent from the option text (unit test on the guard function, not on generated output).
- Pack: pact-of-the-chain carries the four extension forms (one assertion).
- Runtime: a warlock character holding Pact of the Chain with a Find Familiar bond can recast_bonded_summon reform into creature:imp; a wizard (no pact) is refused imp with the forms list; a warlock with Pact of the Tome is refused imp. Use the existing recastBondedSummon tests' fixtures.

PROTOCOL: run `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites files); commit on eshyra-olv1.1; append a completion report with `bd update eshyra-olv1.1 --append-notes` (changes, decisions incl. item 3 finding, tests, verify result, follow-ups); file follow-ups with bd create; `bd close eshyra-olv1.1`.
